title: Lion cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,30 62,30' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 38,30 50,30' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='22' r='2' fill='#4ecdc4'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='22' r='2' fill='#4ecdc4'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='41' r='9' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='41' r='9' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='41' r='5' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='41' r='5' fill='#f7c873'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='25' fill='#f2b33d'/>

  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#d97c1e' stroke-width='5' stroke-dasharray='6 5'/>

  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#fce3a6'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='4' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='4' fill='#3b2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='49' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='50,58 46,62 54,62' fill='#b05a2a'/>

  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 62 Q46 68 42 66' fill='none' stroke='#8a3b1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 62 Q54 68 58 66' fill='none' stroke='#8a3b1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff9aa2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ff9aa2' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='58' x2='38' y2='60' stroke='#d97c1e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='63' x2='38' y2='63' stroke='#d97c1e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='58' x2='62' y2='60' stroke='#d97c1e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='63' x2='62' y2='63' stroke='#d97c1e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little paws -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#f2b33d'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='86' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#f2b33d'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='86' r='2' fill='#fce3a6'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='88' r='2' fill='#fce3a6'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='86' r='2' fill='#fce3a6'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='86' r='2' fill='#fce3a6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='88' r='2' fill='#fce3a6'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='86' r='2' fill='#fce3a6'/>
</svg>
